performance.same_setting: First compare old int vs byte OR with the identical GCC O3,unroll-loops pragma; separate column compares the same byte driver underO2 vsO3/unroll
performance.conclusion: Same flags: maximum dense about0.479x, maximum sparse0.702x, random-sparse0.669x, threshold-density0.603x; small is process-start variability. CandidateO2 is1.3–8.2% slower on large profiles than candidateO3/unroll, so retainO3/unroll.
performance.rss_note: Single sample with stdout /dev/null, recorded for maxRSS only, not substituted for primary file-output AB wall times.
performance.scope: Whole program main+I/O under identical library/commonI/O/compiler/input; no library-only benchmark claim
